scope: Local catalog/CMS/products/variants fixture; cart/Seller writes mocked. No real database, checkout, payment or product approval workflow run. SwiftShader renders WebGL.
before_fix: Three outfit regression cases failed on v8: retained variant, unresolved draft references, and retry with an already-added sold-out item.

tests.title: Quick View selects a live variant, adds once and restores focus on Escape
Quick View recovers from fetch failure and size advice applies the shop chart
product size advice handles missing charts without inventing a size
outfit persists selected variants, totals live prices and retries only failed items
outfit detects changed prices before posting cart items
unavailable saved selections are explained and untouched drafts survive failed loading
outfit rejects duplicate variants and guests go to login with the draft intact
mobile outfit and Quick View fit and remain operable
Seller saves a chart without losing other attributes and rejects reversed ranges
editing an outfit item retains its selected variant
editing another slot preserves saved references that could not reload
retry ignores stock changes of items already added successfully
size selection is locked while a Quick View cart request is pending
pointer movement in Quick View does not tilt the card behind the modal
a stalled preview request times out with a retry message
product depth tracks mouse, clears on leave and preserves wishlist and navigation
global motion off and reduced motion neutralize depth
orb tuning changes actual shader glow and resets selected values
touch scrolling does not tilt cards and mobile controls fit
editorial depth leaves shopping links and product zoom usable
home renders a live catalog, new images and working collection filters
collection recovers from a failed request and stale replies cannot replace the chosen filter
motion can be paused, persists across reload, and follows reduced-motion settings
mobile home and both auth modes fit without yellow panels or hidden controls
ThreeUI renders locally, animates and does not block shopping links
turning motion off removes the renderer and keeps the preference on reload
offscreen and hidden pages release the frame and recreate it when visible
reduced motion skips the effect download; live preference changes remove it
unavailable decorative source leaves the catalog and navigation usable
mobile resizes the canvas without horizontal overflow or focusable decoration
3D orb draws WebGL pixels, changes palette and keeps its shopping link usable
pause, offscreen and hidden tab release the WebGL renderer
reduced motion uses the still sphere without loading the WebGL component
unsupported WebGL still leaves the sphere and controls usable
WebGL context loss falls back and can restart
3D section and controls fit a 320px screen
